query: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1) AND p.price > 0), 2) AS percentage_above_avg FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1) AND price > 0 AND price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND price > 0)
